Paragraph: "Yet even this golden mist cannot brighten the darkness that has settled upon my soul without Seetha..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Internal emotional darkness persisting despite bright, radiant external light.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama acknowledges the depth of his depression and inner darkness.
Outcome/Resolution: He contrasts external luminosity with his internal state.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Tamas (Qualitative darkness/gloom enveloping the intellect due to extreme grief)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Without spiritual connection (Seetha), external light cannot penetrate the inner gloom of the separated mind.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Depressive realism: acknowledging that bright external conditions cannot dissolve deeply rooted emotional sorrow.
